summary: Iter 9 test pass: 34 PASS / 1 SKIP / 2 FAIL backend (test_iteration9.py). Generic CRUD framework verified — PATCH/DELETE work for all 11 entities, unknown entity returns 404, cross-tenant returns 404, soft-delete works on crews. Onboarding endpoint returns 12 well-shaped steps with completed_count matching DB state. Auto-detect-rooms reads pdf_url correctly, returns 200 (0 detected on synthetic PDFs — expected). Copilot envelope standardised for create_task / create_crew / update_task / delete_entity / create_delay / create_safety_event / create_qc_issue / create_delivery. Frontend smoke pass for /getting-started, /resources/{crews,people,equipment,certifications}, /rfis, /deliveries, /work-items, /change-orders, /polygon-editor — all render CrudList tables and the polygon-editor AI buttons are visible. TWO COPILOT ENVELOPE BUGS FOUND for create_person and create_equipment.

critical.issue: Envelope returns {resource:'person', id, name:'Jane Smith'} instead of the spec's required first_name/last_name fields. Root cause: SYSTEM_PROMPT in services/copilot_tools.py:59 advertises arg as `full_name: str` so the model passes full_name; tool implementation (line 423) correctly stores first_name/last_name in DB but the returned envelope at line 440 only exposes a concatenated `name`. Fix: (a) update SYSTEM_PROMPT line 59 to `args: {first_name: str, last_name: str, email?, phone?, trade?, role?, hourly_rate_usd?}`; (b) change line 440 envelope to `{'created': {'resource':'person', 'id': doc['id'], 'first_name': first_name, 'last_name': last_name}}`

Envelope returns only {resource:'equipment', id, asset_tag, type} — missing canonical fields manufacturer/model/year/ownership even when the user explicitly supplies them. Root cause: SYSTEM_PROMPT line 60 advertises legacy args `{name, equipment_type, owner, hourly_rate_usd}` instead of canonical `{asset_tag, type, manufacturer, model, year, ownership}`, so the AI never passes manufacturer/model/year/ownership. The tool DOES persist them (line 451-453) but the envelope at line 464 doesn't echo them. Reproduction: prompt 'Add equipment: asset tag E-001, type excavator, model CAT 320, manufacturer Caterpillar, year 2020, ownership owned' → envelope = {'resource':'equipment','id':...,'asset_tag':'E-A32933','type':'excavator'} (note the asset_tag 'E-A32933' is a regenerated random one — proves AI didn't pass asset_tag through either). Fix: (a) update SYSTEM_PROMPT line 60 to canonical args; (b) extend envelope at line 464 to include manufacturer/model/year/ownership from the persisted doc.

copilot_tools.py SYSTEM_PROMPT is the source of contract for the LLM. The prompt for create_person and create_equipment advertises legacy fields, which means even if the underlying tool stores the canonical fields, the AI never knows to pass them. This is the actual root cause; envelope shape is the symptom.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 (create_person envelope): SYSTEM_PROMPT advertises `full_name: str` so AI passes `full_name=Jane Smith`. Tool _tool_create_person at services/copilot_tools.py:408 splits full_name into first/last and DOES persist them to DB, but the returned envelope at line 440 is `{'created': {'resource':'person','id':doc['id'],'name': f'{first_name} {last_name}'}}` — wrong shape. BUG 2 (create_equipment envelope): SYSTEM_PROMPT line 60 advertises legacy args (`name`, `equipment_type`, `owner`); when user prompts with canonical fields, the AI gets confused — it passes asset_tag='E-001' but the tool runs the asset_tag fallback (line 447: `f"E-{gen_id()[:6].upper()}"`) because canonical asset_tag passes through args.get correctly. The envelope at line 464 only exposes asset_tag+type+resource+id, dropping manufacturer/model/year/ownership even though they ARE persisted (lines 451-455). FIX: (a) Update SYSTEM_PROMPT to advertise canonical args; (b) Expand envelope return shape to include all canonical fields from persisted doc.
